review_policy: internal mathematical review; no novelty claim

records.title: Exponential improvement in the local-optimum count
records.statement: For independent uniform[0,1] costs on K_n, E[M_n] = O((6/7)^n sqrt(n!)), where undirected tours are identified up to rotation and reversal.
records.remaining: Originality and external peer review are not established. No tour-quality, basin-size, descent-time, or efficient exact-solving conclusion follows.

records.title: Exact forced-edge 1-tree certificates
records.statement: Exact forced-edge rooted 1-tree lower bounds justify strict deletion L_e > U. An integer-arithmetic implementation and independent Kruskal checker agree on 147 packets; a separate exhaustive audit verifies 1,280 forced bounds.
records.remaining: Known sensitivity mathematics; no novelty claim. The 48-instance metric experiment has sizes 8, 10, 12; no scalable solver benchmark.

records.title: Complete residual graph on every tree metric
records.statement: For a nonnegative weighted tree on all n tour vertices, every metric edge belongs to some optimum of cost twice the total tree weight. Any elimination preserving all optimal tours must retain K_n, of treewidth n-1.
records.remaining: Preserving one selected optimum and using the sparse generating tree remain possible. No general structural guarantee follows for other metric families.

records.title: Complete residual density with a positive LP gap
records.statement: The Petersen (1,2)-metric has optimum 11 and subtour-LP value 10; all 45 metric edges occur in optimal tours, so all-optima preservation retains K_10.
records.remaining: Finite example with explicit tour witnesses and every proper cut checked; it supplies no asymptotic gap theorem.
